payload.posture: Read John 20:11–18 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states mary weeps, sees two angels, mistakes Jesus for the gardener, recognizes him when named, and carries his message to the disciples. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
